It sells [[beauty]], [[Wellness (alternative medicine)|wellness]] and [[fashion]] products online and through physical stores.{{cite web |title=Nykaa Q2 results: Net profit surges to Rs 34.4 crore; revenue jumps 25% |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/nykaa-q2-results-net-profit-surges-to-rs-34-4-crore-revenue-jumps-25/articleshow/125162130.cms |website=The Times of India |date=7 November 2025}} It also operates an eB2B distribution business called Superstore by Nykaa.{{cite web |title=Nykaa eyes Rs 6,000 crore GMV from in-house brands by FY30, ramps up fashion and AI bets |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/nykaa-eyes-rs-6000-crore-gmv-from-in-house-brands-by-fy30-ramps-up-fashion-and-ai-bets/articleshow/122096154.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=26 June 2025}} In 2020, it became the first Indian [[unicorn (finance)|unicorn startup]] headed by a woman.{{Cite web|date=October 28, 2021|title=Falguni Nayar, Founder Of India's First Woman-Led Unicorn Nykaa: Profile|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/falguni-nayar-founder-of-indias-first-woman-led-unicorn-nykaa-profile-2590610|access-date=2021-11-05|website=NDTV.com}} Nykaa was listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] in November 2021 following its initial public offering.{{cite web |title=Nykaa IPO to open for public subscription on October 28, sets price band of ₹1,085-1,125 a share |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/markets/nykaa-ipo-to-open-for-public-subscription-on-october-28/article37121578.ece |website=The Hindu |language=en-IN |date=22 October 2021}} ==History== [[File:NYKAA.COM LOGO.jpg|thumb|Logo used in the initial years.]] Nykaa was founded in April 2012 by Falguni Nayar, a former investment banker and Managing Director at [[Kotak Mahindra]] Capital.{{cite web |title=Get A Glimpse Into The Mind Of Falguni Nayar, The Woman Behind The Force That Is Nykaa |url=https://www.idiva.com/career/advice/get-a-glimpse-into-the-mind-of-falguni-nayar-the-woman-behind-the-force-that-is-nykaa/17030893 |website=iDiva |access-date=14 November 2021 |language=en-IN |date=8 March 2017}} The company launched as an online beauty retailer in 2012 and began commercial operations in 2013. Its first offline store opened in the Delhi airport in 2014.{{Cite news|last=Kapur|first=Mallika|url=https://www.livemint.com/Leisure/EMOmjllb5hPv8Se8T62ZaK/Falguni-Nayar-The-beauty-entrepreneur.html|title=Falguni Nayar: The beauty entrepreneur|date=24 March 2017|work=Live Mint|access-date=2 April 2020}}{{cite news|title=Shades in Beauty Space: Falguni Nayar|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/slideshows/biz-entrepreneurship/meet-five-ex-bankers-who-broke-free-with-radically-different-ventures/slideshow/18842074.cms|website=Economictimes.indiatimes.com|access-date=7 March 2013}} In 2015, Nykaa launched its own brands with Nykaa Cosmetics. Its owned brands would later develop into its House of Nykaa business.{{Cite web|url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/marketing/nykaa-reveales-its-omni-channel-content-and-guided-selling-strategy/70841130|title=Nykaa reveales its omni-channel content and guided selling strategy|website=ETBrandEquity.com}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/nykaa-bets-big-on-fashion-offline-stores-with-eye-on-unicorn-tag-119041900920_1.html|title=Nykaa bets big on fashion, offline stores with eye on Unicorn tag|first=Pavan|last=Lall|newspaper=Business Standard India|date=19 April 2019|via=Business Standard}} In 2018, Nykaa expanded into fashion with the launch of Nykaa Fashion.{{cite news |title=Nykaa launches Nykaa Network to boost interactivity |url=https://in.fashionnetwork.com/news/nykaa-launches-nykaa-network-to-boost-interactivity,999565.html |access-date=17 November 2022 |work=FashionNetwork.com |language=en-IN}}{{cite web |title=From startup to beauty giant- How Falguni Nayar built a $5.39 billion empire - CNBC TV18 |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/from-startup-to-beauty-giant-how-falguni-nayar-built-a-5-39-billion-empire-19565306.htm |website=CNBCTV18 |language=en |date=3 March 2025}} In 2020, it became the first Indian [[unicorn (finance)|unicorn]] startup headed by a woman.{{Cite news|last=Sai|first=Ishwar|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/nykaa-raises-rs-100-crore-from-existing-investor-steadview-capital-120040100062_1.html|title=Nykaa raises Rs 100 crore from existing investor Steadview Capital|date=1 April 2020|work=Business Standard|access-date=1 April 2020}}{{cite news|title=Max Ventures and Industries acquires 2% stake in Nykaa|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/deals/-ma/max-acquires-2pc-stake-in-Nykaa/articleshow/55897360.cms|newspaper=The Times of India|date=9 December 2016 }} In November 2020, global asset management firm [[Fidelity Investments|Fidelity]] invested in the company through a secondary sale of shares from multiple equity sellers.{{cite web |title=Fidelity invests in Nykaa via secondary shares |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/fidelity-invests-in-nykaa-via-secondary-shares-6160801.html |website=Moneycontrol}} In 2020, the company announced the launch of Nykaa Man the same year, targeting men’s grooming and fashion.{{Cite web|date=2020-10-05|title=Ahead Of Festive Season, Nykaa Offers Men's Fashion, Grooming Products|url=https://inc42.com/buzz/ahead-of-festive-season-nykaa-offers-mens-fashion-grooming-products/|access-date=2021-05-24|website=Inc42 Media|language=en-US}}{{Cite news|last=Srinivasan|first=Supraja|title=Nykaa joins party in men's grooming|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/newsbuzz/nykaa-joins-party-in-mens-grooming/articleshow/64877812.cms?from=mdr|access-date=2021-05-24}} Nykaa opened its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) in late October 2021 and was listed on the NSE and BSE on 10 November 2021.{{cite news |title=Nykaa IPO to open on October 28; priced at Rs 1,085-1,125 apiece|newspaper=Business Standard India |date=22 October 2021 |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/markets/nykaa-ipo-opens-oct-28-price-band-at-rs-1-085-1-125-per-share-121102200917_1.html |access-date=13 November 2021|last1=Modak |first1=Samie }} The IPO raised {{INRconvert|5352|c|mode=historical|year=2021}} at a valuation of {{USD}}7.4 billion.{{cite news |title=Nykaa surges to near $13 billion valuation in debut |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/indian-beauty-startup-nykaa-surges-to-near-13-billion-valuation-in-debut/articleshow/87620578.cms |access-date=14 December 2021 |work=The Economic Times}} Following the listing, founder Falguni Nayar became India’s wealthiest self-made female billionaire.{{cite web |title=Nykaa founder Falguni Nayar is now India's wealthiest self-made female billionaire |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/business/nykaa-founder-falguni-nayar-becomes-india-s-wealthiest-self-made-female-billionaire-101636525035358.html |website=Hindustan Times |access-date=13 November 2021 |language=en |date=10 November 2021}} In 2022, Nykaa partnered with [[Apparel Group]] to sell beauty products in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Kuwait and Bahrain.{{cite web |title=Falguni Nayar optimistic about Nykaa's global expansion, sets sights on GCC market |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/expert-view/falguni-nayar-optimistic-about-nykaas-global-expansion-sets-sights-on-gcc-market/articleshow/118138207.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=11 February 2025}}{{cite web |title=How Nykaa became the go-to launchpad for global brands |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/brandwagon-how-nykaa-became-the-go-to-launchpad-for-global-brands-3841100/ |website=The Financial Express |language=en |date=13 May 2025}} In 2024, Nykaa and the Apparel Group entered a 55:45 joint venture to launch Nysaa in Gulf countries.{{cite web |title=Nykaa & Apparel Group Agreement {{!}} APPAREL GROUP |url=https://www.apparelgroup.com/en/news/nykaa-enters-into-a-strategic-alliance-with-middle-east-based-apparel-group-to-recreate-omnichannel-beauty-retail-platform-in-the-gcc/ |website=Apparelgroup.com |date=7 October 2022}}{{cite web |title=Nykaa Penetrates The Gulf Countries. Through Its First International Corporation With An Apparel Group |url=https://www.inventiva.co.in/trends/nykaa-penetrates-the-gulf-countries/ |website=Inventiva.co.in |date=8 October 2022}}{{cite web |title=Apparel Group and Nyka forge alliance |url=https://gulfnews.com/friday/apparel-group-and-nyka-forge-alliance-1.91108156 |website=Gulf News |language=en |date=7 October 2022}} ==Operations== Nykaa operates a hybrid model, with an inventory-led approach for beauty and personal care products and a marketplace model for fashion.{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/current/corporate/nykaa-fashion-starts-offline-expansion-first-store-to-open-in-delhi-ambience-mall/story/423921.html|title=Nykaa Fashion starts offline expansion, first store to open in Delhi's Ambience Mall|website=www.businesstoday.in|date=4 December 2020 }}{{cite news|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/fashion-/-cosmetics-/-jewellery/nykaa-decks-up-to-woo-indian-beauty-market-with-more-products-and-services/articleshow/52825419.cms|title=Nykaa decks up to woo Indian beauty market with more products and services |newspaper=The Economic Times|last1=Ganguly |first1=Payal }}{{Cite web|url=https://retail.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/health-and-beauty/beauty-startup-nykaa-plans-3-billion-ipo-this-year/80116523|title=Beauty startup Nykaa plans $3 billion IPO this year – ET Retail|website=ETRetail.com}} It has three offline store formats called Nykaa Luxe, Nykaa On Trend and Nykaa beauty kiosks. The Luxe format features international luxury beauty brands such as [[Huda Beauty]], MAC, [[Dior]], and [[Givenchy]], along with Nykaa Beauty, the in-house collection of beauty products.{{Cite web|url=https://www.vogue.in/beauty/content/everything-you-need-to-know-about-the-new-nykaa-luxe-store-in-mumbai|title=Everything you need to know about the new Nykaa Luxe store in Mumbai|first=Avanti|last=Dalal|website=Vogue India|date=29 January 2021}} The Nykaa On Trend sells curated products.{{cite web|title=Nykaa to expand offline presence|url=http://www.deccanherald.com/content/619105/nykaa-expand-offline-presence.html|website=Deccanherald.com|date=25 June 2017}} Nykaa has retail and distribution subsidiaries in the [[Gulf region]], including Nysaa Cosmetics Trading in Qatar for the export and retail sale of beauty and personal care products, and Nysaa Trading LLC in Saudi Arabia.{{cite web |title=Nykaa, Apparel Group to open 70 Nysaa stores in 5 years: CEO Falguni Nayar |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/business/brandwagon-nykaa-apparel-group-to-open-70-nyssa-stores-in-5-years-ceo-falguni-nayyar-3429514/ |website=The Financial Express |language=en |date=19 March 2024}} ===House of Nykaa=== Nykaa has in-house brands within beauty and fashion. Some of them include: * Beauty Brands – Dot & Key, Nykaa Naturals, Nykaa Cosmetics, Kay Beauty * Nykaa Fashion – Nykd by Nykaa, 20 Dresses, RSVP, Mondano, Likha,{{Cite web|url=https://www.apnnews.com/nykaa-launches-new-category-nykd-all-day-featuring-athleisure-leisure-activewear-exclusively-on-nykaa-fashion/|title=Nykaa launches new category Nykd All Day – Featuring Athleisure, Leisure & Activewear exclusively on Nykaa Fashion|date=15 April 2021 }} Pipa Bella{{Cite news|title=Nykaa Fashion acquires Pipa Bella to strengthen jewellery category|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/nykaa-fashion-acquires-pipa-bella-to-strengthen-jewellery-category/articleshow/82034659.cms|access-date=2021-05-24}}{{Cite Bella|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/nykaa-fashion-acquires-online-jewellery-retailer-pipa-bella-11618209976044.html|access-date=2021-05-24|website=mint|language=en}} In 2015, Nykaa launched its collection of in-house beauty products via Nykaa Cosmetics.{{cite web|title=Nykaa expects private label revenue contribution to double in 2017–18|url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/GmnyDEcjxafpbxQoiEJpGK/Nykaa-expects-private-label-revenue-contribution-to-double-i.html|website=Livemint.com|date=16 December 2016}}{{cite web|url=http://www.livemint.com/Companies/LM5XPiYTUKunXMlskVrjML/Nykaa-looks-to-raise-Rs-100-crore-expand-private-label-offe.html|title=Nykaa looks to raise Rs 100 crore, expand private label offerings|first=Shrutika|last=Verma|date=9 March 2016|website=Livemint.com|access-date=29 June 2018}} Nykaa Naturals sells skincare and personal care products.{{Cite web|url=https://www.indiaretailing.com/2021/02/03/beauty-and-wellness/nykaa-naturals-branches-out-into-a-new-category-launches-hair-care-range/|title=Nykaa Naturals branches out into a new category, launches hair care range|first=Indiaretailing|last=Bureau|date=3 February 2021}} In early 2019, the brand launched its Wanderlust Bath & Body collection, and later in the year introduced a beauty line with designer [[Masaba Gupta]], Masaba by Nykaa.{{Cite web|url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/cities/delhi/2020/jul/07/nykaa-beauty-enters-the-essentials-category-2166464.html|title=Nykaa Beauty enters the essentials category|website=The New Indian Express|date=7 July 2020 }}{{Cite web|url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/magazine/2020/jun/21/scent-and-sensibility-2158336.html|title=Masaba Gupta collaborates with Nykaa to launch fragrance collection|website=The New Indian Express|date=20 June 2020 }} The same year, it launched its first celebrity partnership brand, Kay Beauty, with actress [[Katrina Kaif]].{{Cite web|url=https://qz.com/india/1733852/nykaas-falguni-nayar-on-katrina-kaif-partnership-and-more/|title=Nykaa was an obvious choice for Katrina Kaif over Amazon and Flipkart|first=Ananya|last=Bhattacharya|website=Quartz India|date=24 October 2019 }}{{Cite web|url=https://www.vogue.in/beauty/content/katrina-kaif-launches-new-makeup-line-kay-beauty-on-nykaa|title=Katrina Kaif finally reveals her much-awaited makeup line on Instagram|website=Vogue India|date=16 October 2019}} Kay beauty also retails in UK through a partnership with luxury beauty retailer Space NK.{{cite web |title=Nykaa debuts in UK with Kay Beauty launch |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/nykaa-expands-to-the-uk-with-kay-beauty/articleshow/123825946.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=12 September 2025}} === Acquisitions === In May 2019, Nykaa acquired 20Dresses.com, a private women's styling platform.{{Cite web|url=https://www.techcircle.in/2019/03/22/exclusive-beauty-e-tailer-nykaa-acquires-women-styling-platform-20dresses-com|title=Exclusive: Beauty e-tailer Nykaa acquires women styling platform 20Dresses.com|date=22 March 2019|website=Techcircle}} In 2021, Nykaa Fashion acquired the India fashion jewellery brand, Pipa Bella,{{Cite web|title=Nykaa Fashion acquires jewellery brand Pipa Bella|url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/retail/nykaa-fashion-acquires-jewellery-brand-pipa-bella-8900511.htm|access-date=2021-05-24|website=cnbctv18.com|date=12 April 2021|language=en-US}} and 51% stake in the Indian skincare brand, Dot & Key (additional 39% acquired in 2024).{{cite web |title=Nykaa raises stake in Dot & Key, to acquire Earth Rhythm for Rs 44.5 crore |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/nykaa-raises-stake-in-dot-key-to-acquire-earth-rhythm-for-rs-44-5-crore-124081301544_1.html |website=Business Standard}}{{Cite web |agency=TNN|date=Oct 23, 2021 |title=nykaa: Nykaa buys skincare co Dot & Key {{!}} Bengaluru News - Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bengaluru/nykaa-buys-skincare-co-dot-key/articleshow/87215397.cms |access-date=2022-05-23 |website=The Times of India |language=en}} In 2022, Nykaa acquired an 18.51% stake in Indian [[skincare]] brand Earth Rhythm (majority stake acquired in 2024).{{cite web |title=Nykaa acquires majority stake in clean beauty brand Earth Rhythm |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/nykaa-acquires-majority-stake-in-clean-beauty-brand-earth-rhythm-124112700944_1.html |website=Business Standard}}{{Cite web |title=Nykaa acquires 18.51% stake in beauty brand Earth Rhythm for Rs 41.65 crore |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/mergers-acquisitions/nykaa-buys-stake-in-homegrown-d2c-brand-earth-rhythm-8395781.html |access-date=2022-04-22 |website=Moneycontrol |date=22 April 2022 |language=en}} It then completed the 100% acquisition of lifestyle content platform Little Black Book (LBB).{{cite news |last1=Thathoo |first1=Chetan |title=Nykaa Completes 100% Acquisition Of Digital Content Platform Little Black Book |url=https://inc42.com/buzz/nykaa-completes-100-acquisition-of-digital-content-platform-little-black-book/ |access-date=19 December 2022 |work=Inc42 Media |date=10 September 2022 |language=en}} In the same year, it acquired 60% stake in dietary supplements and nutricosmetics brand Nudge Wellness (100% acquired in 2025) and 100% stake in [[athleisure]] brand KICA.{{cite web |title=Nykaa to acquire balance 40% stake in Nudge Wellness for Rs 15 lakh |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/nykaa-to-bag-balance-40-stake-in-nudge-wellness-for-rs-15-lakh/articleshow/123259274.cms?from=mdr |website=The Economic Times |date=12 August |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/nykaa-acquires-stakes-in-earth-rhythm-kica-and-nudge-wellness-11650625945344.html |website=mint |language=en |date=22 April 2022}} ==Awards and Recognitions== *Featured in TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2022){{cite web |title=Time 100 most influential companies of 2022 |url=https://time.com/collection/time100-companies-2022/6159434/nykaa/ |website=Time.com}} *The Disruptor of the Year at 17th India Business Leader Awards, 2022{{cite web |title=Nykaa awarded The Disruptor of the Year at 17th India Business Leader Awards |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/nykaa-awarded-the-disruptor-of-the-year-at-17th-india-business-leader-awards-8306521.html |website=Moneycontrol}} *Featured on Kantar BrandZ 2022 list as one of India’s most valuable brands{{cite web |title=Kantar BrandZ India Top 75 brands rebound from the pandemic with world-leading brand value growth |url=https://www.kantar.com/inspiration/brands/tata-consultancy-services-becomes-indias-most-valuable-brand |website=www.kantar.com |language=en}} == Content platforms == Nykaa hosts beauty and fashion content its YouTube channel, Nykaa TV. It contains informational videos about beauty, cosmetics, and styling.{{Cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/why-nykaa-has-chosen-to-largely-market-products-via-influencers-6191331.html|title=Nykaa Adopts 360-degree Marketing Strategy To Promote Products; But Influencers Play A Vital Role|website=Moneycontrol|date=4 December 2020 }} Since 2018, it has been hosting an online community of beauty and fashion enthusiasts via its Nykaa Network. In 2020, it launched a web miniseries called The Beauty Bar. Nykaa also hosts Beauty Book, a beauty and fashion magazine.{{citation needed|date=July 2026}} == Other activities == Since 2015, Nykaa has hosted the ‘Nykaa Femina Beauty Awards’ in partnership with women's lifestyle magazine ''[[Femina (India)]]''.{{cite news|title= Nykaa and Femina host the Nykaa Femina Beauty Awards in Mumbai |url= http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/events/mumbai/Nykaa-com-and-Femina-host-the-Nykaa-Femina-Beauty-Awards-in-Mumbai/articleshow/50889774.cms|website=Timesofindia.indiatimes.com}} In 2019, Nykaa Fashion launched ‘The Power List’ in partnership with ''[[Vogue India]]''.{{cn|date=November 2025}} ==Criticism== ===Security issues=== On 18 November 2019, an [[Application programming interface|API]] flaw was detected in Nykaa Fashion's internal systems that allowed a potential attacker to log in to any user account if the attacker had access to the user's email ID.{{cite news |title=Nykaa fixes a data security bug |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/small-biz/startups/newsbuzz/nykaa-fixes-a-data-security-bug/articleshow/72101784.cms |website=Economic Times |access-date=3 December 2019|last1=Kar |first1=Sanghamitra }}{{cite web | url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/start-ups/security-expert-pokes-holes-in-consumer-internet-platforms-11573963913626.html |title=Flaws in code put customer data of four consumer internet platforms at risk |website=Live Mint |date=17 November 2019 |access-date=3 December 2019}} Consequently, the company fixed the security vulnerability. ===Corporate governance=== In November 2022, Nykaa issued 5:1 [[bonus shares]] to coincide with the expiry date of pre-IPO shareholders' lock-in period. The bonus issue resulted in the company's [[corporate governance]] practices receiving heavy criticism, with questions raised over the timing and motive of the issuance along with concerns of [[market manipulation]] and [[tax avoidance]].{{cite news |title=Nykaa's bonus issue {{!}} What does it mean for the company's corporate governance record? |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/nykaas-bonus-issue-what-does-it-mean-for-the-companys-corporate-governance-record-9499681.html |access-date=23 January 2023 |work=Moneycontrol FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd, doing business as Nykaa, is an Indian retail company, headquartered in Mumbai. It sells beauty, wellness and fashion products online and through physical stores. It also operates an eB2B distribution business called Superstore by Nykaa.
In 2020, it became the first Indian unicorn startup headed by a woman.  Nykaa was listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange in November 2021 following its initial public offering.
